workspace.title: Root workspace uses Turbo and Yarn PnP
workspace.test: The repository root must be a private Turbo monorepo using Yarn Plug'n'Play workspaces for apps and packages.

steps.instruction: Inspect package.json, .yarnrc.yml, turbo.json, tsconfig.json, and tsconfig.base.json.
steps.expected: Root package.json is private, declares apps/* and packages/* workspaces, has turbo-backed build/test/deploy scripts, .yarnrc.yml uses pnp, turbo.json exists, and root tsconfig references workspace projects.
steps.descript: Root manifests implement the Turbo monorepo contract.
evidence: package.json has private true and workspaces ["apps/*","packages/*"].
.yarnrc.yml contains nodeLinker: pnp.
turbo.json defines build/test tasks and tsconfig.json references packages/ndx, apps/ndx, and apps/ndxserver.

steps.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable and yarn build.
steps.expected: Both commands complete successfully without creating node_modules.
steps.descript: Immutable install and Turbo build completed successfully.
evidence: yarn install --immutable exited 0.
yarn build exited 0 with 4 successful Turbo tasks.
.gitignore excludes node_modules and no workspace node_modules tree was created.

packages.title: Domain package owns ndx logic
packages.test: The ndx domain implementation must live under packages/ndx and expose stable subpath exports.

steps.expected: The package is named @neurondev/ndx-core and contains cli, server, dashboard, config, model, agent, runtime, process, tools, and shared source folders.
steps.descript: The core package owns the required domain folders.
evidence: packages/ndx/package.json name is @neurondev/ndx-core.
find packages/ndx/src -maxdepth 2 includes cli, server, dashboard, config, model, agent, runtime, process, tools, and shared.

steps.expected: The package exports ., ./cli, ./server, ./dashboard, and ./shared from dist files.
steps.descript: The core package exposes the planned subpaths from dist.
evidence: packages/ndx/package.json exports ., ./cli, ./server, ./dashboard, ./shared, and ./package.json.
yarn build produced dist entrypoints for those exports.

packages.title: Dependencies remain app-to-package and acyclic
packages.test: Apps may depend on packages, but packages must not depend on apps. packages/ndx internal source must not create the previous session-runtime-agent-session cycle.

steps.instruction: Search packages for imports from apps and inspect app package dependencies.
steps.expected: No package source imports apps/*, and app packages depend on @neurondev/ndx-core.
steps.descript: packages/ndx does not import app code and apps depend on the core package.
evidence: rg "apps/|../../apps|from ['\"].*apps" packages/ndx/src returned no matches.
apps/ndx/package.json depends on @neurondev/ndx-core: workspace:^.
apps/ndxserver/package.json depends on @neurondev/ndx-core: workspace:^.

steps.instruction: Inspect imports among packages/ndx/src/server, runtime, agent, and tools.
steps.expected: runtime does not import agent, agent does not import server/session, and the old session -> runtime -> agent -> session cycle is absent.
steps.descript: The old runtime-agent-session cycle is broken by runner injection and top-level tools.
evidence: packages/ndx/src/runtime/runtime.ts defines RuntimeAgentRunner and has no import from ../agent.
packages/ndx/src/session/server.ts imports runAgent and passes runAgent into new AgentRuntime.
packages/ndx/src/agent/loop.ts imports ../tools/registry.js, ../tools/process-runner.js, and ../tools/schema.js, not session tools.
rg over runtime/agent/tools for agent-loop/session-server cycle only found tools/external/runner.ts importing ../../session/sandbox-paths.js for path mapping.

apps.title: Apps are thin wrappers and preserve bins
apps.test: apps/ndx and apps/ndxserver must be thin wrappers over @neurondev/ndx-core while @neurondev/ndx still publishes ndx and ndxserver bins.

steps.instruction: Inspect apps/ndx and apps/ndxserver source files.
steps.expected: App sources only import @neurondev/ndx-core subpaths and invoke exported entrypoints; they do not contain argument parsing, config loading, session orchestration, dashboard rendering, or Docker sandbox logic.
steps.descript: App sources are bin loaders only.
evidence: apps/ndx/src/bin/ndx.ts imports loadCoreCli and calls main().
apps/ndx/src/bin/ndxserver.ts and apps/ndxserver/src/bin/ndxserver.ts set NDX_INVOKED_AS_SERVER and call core main().
rg over app sources found no config loading, SessionServer construction, dashboard rendering, or Docker sandbox implementation.

steps.instruction: Build the workspace, then run apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndx.js --version and apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version.
steps.expected: Both commands print the package version and exit successfully.
steps.descript: Built app bins print the expected version.
evidence: yarn build exited 0.
node apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndx.js --version printed 0.1.35.
node apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version printed 0.1.35.
node apps/ndxserver/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version printed 0.1.35.

steps.instruction: Run yarn workspace @neurondev/ndx npm pack --dry-run and inspect the package files.
steps.expected: The publish package includes compiled bin files for ndx and ndxserver and compiled app files, without source-only dependency on the root src folder.
steps.descript: The Yarn 4 pack dry-run includes compiled bin files and package docs.
evidence: yarn workspace @neurondev/ndx pack --dry-run exited 0.
Dry-run output included dist/bin/ndx.js and dist/bin/ndxserver.js.
Packed package.json rewrites @neurondev/ndx-core dependency to ^0.1.35.
Temporary prefix install from /tmp/ndx-core.tgz and /tmp/ndx-app.tgz ran /tmp/ndx-global/bin/ndx --version and /tmp/ndx-global/bin/ndxserver --version, both printing 0.1.35.

apps.title: Toolcontainer owns sandbox image
apps.test: The sandbox Dockerfile must live under apps/toolcontainer and compose must build from that app.

steps.expected: docker-compose.yml builds ndx-sandbox from apps/toolcontainer and the Dockerfile preserves the existing sandbox runtime packages and apply_patch helper.
steps.descript: Compose builds the sandbox from apps/toolcontainer and the Dockerfile keeps the original runtime contract.
evidence: docker-compose.yml ndx-sandbox build.context is apps/toolcontainer.
apps/toolcontainer/Dockerfile starts FROM node:22-bookworm-slim.
Dockerfile installs bash, git, jq, patch, python3, ripgrep, wget, xz-utils, Playwright Chromium, and /usr/local/bin/apply_patch.
npm run deploy built hika00/ndx-sandbox:0.1.1 and verified the sandbox write.

documentation.title: Docs describe the monorepo contract
documentation.test: Root and package documentation must describe the monorepo layout, public interfaces, dependency rules, and test/deploy process.

steps.instruction: Inspect README.md and docs/overview.md, architecture.md, api.md, usage.md, constraints.md, internals.md, and testing.md.
steps.expected: The docs describe apps/ndx, apps/ndxserver, apps/toolcontainer, packages/ndx, Turbo build, bin compatibility, dependency direction, and agenttest/deploy verification.
steps.descript: Root docs describe the new monorepo and verification contract.
evidence: README.md describes apps/ndx, apps/ndxserver, apps/toolcontainer, packages/ndx, install bins, and npm run deploy.
docs/architecture.md documents workspace layout and dependency direction.
docs/testing.md documents Turbo build, agenttest policy, deploy, and monorepo package-boundary coverage.

steps.expected: packages/ndx has README.md plus docs/overview.md, architecture.md, api.md, usage.md, constraints.md, internals.md, and testing.md.
steps.descript: The core package has the required README and docs set.
evidence: packages/ndx/README.md exists with a nav table.
packages/ndx/docs contains overview.md, architecture.md, api.md, usage.md, constraints.md, internals.md, and testing.md.
App package README/docs were also added under apps/ndx, apps/ndxserver, and apps/toolcontainer.

deploy.title: Deploy verifies build and sandbox
deploy.test: The final deploy path must build the monorepo, run the policy test hook, refresh Docker compose, verify sandbox write, and tear down compose.

steps.expected: The deploy command completes successfully and its output includes Turbo build execution, Docker compose down, compose build, compose up, sandbox write verification, and final compose down.
steps.descript: The full deploy command completed the build, policy hook, compose refresh, sandbox write, and teardown.
evidence: npm run deploy exited 0.
Deploy output included turbo 2.9.9 with 4 successful build tasks.
Deploy output included agenttest policy hook: strict JSON results under test/YYYYMMDD.
Deploy output built docker.io/hika00/ndx-sandbox:0.1.1 from apps/toolcontainer.
Deploy output created, started, stopped, removed ndx-ndx-sandbox-1, then removed ndx_default network.
